test_command: npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && { rm -f node_modules/.bench-result.json; npx jest --config config/jest.config.js tests/doc/foldFlowLines tests/doc/stringify tests/bench_ --json --outputFile=node_modules/.bench-result.json; rc=$?; node -e "const fs=require('fs');const [rc,...h]=process.argv.slice(1);const on=h.some(p=>fs.existsSync(p));let r=null;try{r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('node_modules/.bench-result.json','utf8'))}catch(e){}if(!r){if(rc==='0'){console.log('[setup failed] hidden tests did not run (no test report)');process.exit(1)}process.exit(+rc)}const t=r.testResults||[];const as=x=>x.assertionResults||[];const f=t.filter(x=>x.status==='failed'&&!as(x).some(a=>a.status==='failed'));if(f.length)console.log('[setup failed] '+f.length+' test file(s) failed to load');else if(r.numFailedTests>0)console.log('--- FAIL: '+r.numFailedTests+' test(s) failed');if(rc==='0'&&on&&!t.some(x=>/bench[-_]/.test(x.name.replace(/.*[\x5c/]/,''))&&as(x).some(a=>a.status==='passed')&&!as(x).some(a=>a.status==='failed'))){console.log('[setup failed] hidden tests did not run');process.exit(1)}process.exit(+rc)" "$rc" tests/bench_folded_overflow.ts; }

Agents need no network for tests once the cache is warm.
provenance.test_runner: jest 29 (babel-jest) via the repository's config/jest.config.js; runs the hidden tests plus tests/doc/foldFlowLines.ts and tests/doc/stringify.ts. The yaml-test-suite git submodule is not fetched by the sealed clone and its suite is not run. Hidden-test guard: when the hidden test files are present, a run that exits 0 must show that they ran (jest/vitest: the JSON report has a bench_/bench- test file with at least one passed and no failed assertion; mocha/node:test: the captured output contains a `bench:` suite title); otherwise the command prints `[setup failed] hidden tests did not run` and exits 1.
